Your Instructor

MATT
WATSON

New Zealand's most recognised fishing identity and host of the ITM Fishing Show for 20 seasons. Matt started The Fishing Show in 2003 — mortgaging his house to fund it — and built it into a phenomenon broadcast on Discovery Channel and Animal Planet worldwide.

Now stepping off TV, he's distilling everything he knows into 20 focused online episodes. No filler, no fluff — just real technique from a man who has lived and breathed fishing his entire life.
